summary.en: A vertical picker: the focus pill stays still, the list snaps through it one item a step and holds still each time.
summary.zh: 竖向滚轮：焦点药丸不动，列表一格一格吸附穿过，每格都真停住。

fits: Cycling through features, modes or options one at a time, each held long enough to read.
notFor: More than about seven items; showing everything at once; a free scroll.

intent.en: Choosing is made physical: the content is caught by a fixed focus and truly stops, so each stop reads as "this one is picked".
intent.zh: 把“选择”做出物理感：内容被固定的焦点框吸住并真正停下，每一停都读作“选中了这一项”。

content.en: 3–7 short items (≤ 24 chars each, one line), optionally with an icon each; the number of steps to show.
content.zh: 3–7 个短条目（每条 ≤ 10 字，单行），可各带图标；以及要走几步。

fits.zh: 一项一项轮过功能、模式或选项，每项都停够读完。

notFor.zh: 超过约七项；要一次全部展示（用网格或列表）；自由滚动。

en: Every step must come to a true still for a few frames; continuous scrolling reads as a loading animation.
The focus pill must never move (its breath scales in place), or "content passing through the focus" is lost.
Keep each item on one line (under about 300 px at design size); shrink the type rather than wrap.
zh: 每一步都要真正静止几帧，连续滚动读作加载动画。
焦点药丸位置绝不能动（呼吸只原地缩放），否则“内容穿过焦点”的意思就没了。
每条保持单行（设计尺寸下约 300 px 以内），宁可缩字号也不换行。

upstream.name: 药丸吸附轮播
upstream.summary: 移动端风竖向选择器——焦点药丸不动、内容穿过它，每项带明显 outQuint 减速吸附后完全静止，按到中心距离分层控制透明度/字号/灰度，落定时药丸做 scaleY 极轻呼吸
upstream.use: 逐个念出功能名/场景名的列表镜头；"选一个"的交互演示；移动端产品的 picker 类控件展示
upstream.energy: 中（每一次吸附都是一个节拍点，5 拍匀速推进）
